name: ImageCompare
description: A before/after comparison slider with a draggable divider and round grab handle that clips one image over the other, split left/right or top/bottom. Plays a short hint sweep on mount and ships with built-in CSS gradient landscape scenes so it works without any images.
a11yNotes: The handle is a focusable role="slider" (aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 100, aria-valuenow, aria-orientation) named "Before / After comparison" with an aria-valuetext like "60% Before, 40% After". Arrow keys move by the step, PageUp/PageDown by 10, Home/End jump to the edges. Each side is exposed as an image with its label as alt text; the corner tags are aria-hidden duplicates. Pointer dragging works anywhere on the frame (touch keeps vertical page scrolling). Focus is shown with a 2px outline plus an accent glow. Under prefers-reduced-motion the intro sweep and handle scale are skipped.

propsApi.name: beforeSrc
propsApi.description: URL of the before image; defaults to a desaturated gradient landscape.

propsApi.name: afterSrc
propsApi.description: URL of the after image; defaults to the same landscape in full color.

propsApi.name: beforeLabel
propsApi.description: Corner label and alt text of the before side.

propsApi.name: afterLabel
propsApi.description: Corner label and alt text of the after side.

propsApi.name: defaultValue
propsApi.description: Initial divider position in percent when uncontrolled.

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the new position while dragging or using the keyboard.

propsApi.name: orientation
propsApi.description: Split left/right with a vertical divider, or top/bottom with a horizontal one.

propsApi.name: showLabels
propsApi.description: Show the Before/After corner tags (each fades out as the divider approaches it).

propsApi.name: intro
propsApi.description: Play a short decaying sweep on mount to hint that the divider is draggable.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Handle arrow color and focus glow.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
